items.title: Isidore Barbarin Interview, 1959-01-07
items.q: He wants to know about the band when you played with Joe Oliver. ... Joe Oliver led the band when the 9th Paris went to Chicago.

ctx.x: He wants to know about the band when you played with Joe Oliver. The onward brass band. Tell them about all those musicians that you played with.

Uh. Joe Oliver. Mm-hmm. Joe Oliver led the band when the 9th Paris went to Chicago. You see? Mm-hmm. And he took charge of the band. He was playing second trumpet, you know? Mm-hmm. So when 9th went away, he led the band. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Yeah. Eddie Jackson was playing football.
